rootdir.description: Path to the underlying directory to be mirrored (required)

mountpoint.description: Path where the disorderfs overlay should be mounted (required)

multi_user.description: Whether to allow other users to access the overlay mount (requires root)

shuffle_dirents.description: Whether to randomly shuffle directory entries

reverse_dirents.description: Whether to return directory entries in reverse order

sort_dirents.description: Whether to return directory entries in sorted order

pad_blocks.description: Number to add to the st_blocks field in struct stat(2)

share_locks.description: Whether to share locks between disorderfs and the underlying filesystem
